label: the swell outpost
note: Issue #879: one of the Remnant's five outposts on the tide world (Territory's 'tide' front, content/core/story/territory.json), on a pontoon well out on the open swell. The same building, troopers, droids and rules as the red world's outposts (this file is remnant_outpost_red_flats.json's, renamed), on a pontoon standing out of the sea (PlanetTerrain.outpost_flat_sites: SEA_PAD_HALF, SEA_PAD_LIFT, a ramp all round a speeder rides up), set out as a landmark in content/core/planets/port_tide.json. Reach it by speeder or ship. Kill every trooper here and the locals move in; hold all five at once and the Remnant are driven off the tide world. Local frame: +x faces the port.

zone.note: Issue #308: a ring of radius metres round the outpost is a checkpoint zone. Below the wave band the nearest trooper (a role below) who sees you walks up and the gate's card opens, on the gate's rules (content/core/soldiers/gate_guard.json checkpoint block; anything in this checkpoint block wins). Leave the ring and the card closes; cleared, the outpost leaves you alone for cleared_s.
